notes.title: [TGS2024 Sale & Console release 1st anniv] Campaign with Winnable Prizes!
notes.notes:
Dear brave challengers facing mighty bosses,
This is the TrinityS development team.

Thank you very much for playing TrinityS on a regular basis.

The console version of TrinityS, which was released last year, will celebrate its first anniversary on October 20, 2024!
To commemorate this, we will be holding a [u]campaign[/u] on X (Twitter)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/d7af55447a120017d5044b3e0d3698c2593e85cd.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Campaign Period[/h2]
[list]
[*] September 25th to October 9th 23:59 (JST)  (FYI, it's currently on sale at a 30% discount as part of the TGS2024 sale!)
[/list]
[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]TrinityS original T-shirts for 5 people[/b] (by lottery)
(The design is currently being created. )
[*] [b]TrinityS original acrylic stand[/b]　(A gift for everyone who completes the challenge mission!)
(The image is a sample.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/c95b2012a06064d86c4ef5d6f51bfbad32ab5030.png[/img]
[/olist][h2]How to apply[/h2]

[h3]Original T-shirt lottery[/h3]
Post images or videos of yourself playing on Twitter with the hashtag [u]#TrinityS[/u] to complete your entry!

[h3]GET Acrylic Stand Challenge Mission[/h3]
Clear Hard Mode with a total number of game overs is 30 or less, and post the results screen with the hashtag [u]#TrinityS[/u].

[h3]Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can enter as many times as you like, but only one entry per person will be selected as the winner.
[*] There is a better chance if you post a video.
[*] If the winner is the person who posted the image showing the game being played at the party, it will be given to all the party members.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We look forward to receiving your applications!
Please continue to enjoy TrinityS.

notes.title: [Cross-Play Support] Official Version Release!! [Patch Notes]
notes.notes:
Dear brave challengers facing mighty bosses,
This is the TrinityS development team.

Thank you very much for playing the early access version of "TrinityS" on a regular basis.
After a long hiatus in updates, we are pleased to announce the start of the implementation of [b]cross-play[/b] and the release of the [b]official version[/b]!

With this update, "cross-play" has been implemented, allowing you to play TrinityS not only on the Steam version (PC version) but also with players on the console version (hereinafter referred to as the CS version).

<Update Contents>
[list]
[*]Cross-play support
[*]Addition of "Recently played players"
[*]Addition of communication phrases
[*]Adjustment to existing skills
[*]Discontinuation of cloud saves
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]
Please see below for details.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Update[/b][/h2]

Due to the implementation of cross-play, the content that will be updated may vary depending on the platform, so we have added [PC] [CS] notation to each item.

[h3][b]Cross-Play Support![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/865ec596e0dbfb21c4f7bc94a2de24e39adcd131.jpg[/img]
"Cross-play" has been implemented, allowing players from different platforms to join forces in battle. Additionally, some UI elements have been changed.
[list]
[*][h4][b]Addition of Platform Icons [PC] [CS][/b][/h4]
Icons indicating which platform the player is accessing from have been added to the lobby and battle screens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/96a535815b4eb2bebb055dc4e4c855d247060944.jpg[/img]
[*][h4][b]Shortened Lobby ID [PC] [CS][/b][/h4]
The lobby ID used for lobby searches have been shortened.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/5154bce09f0d3faa3a9291433d39a51ecd501e1c.jpg[/img]
[*][h4][b]Discontinuation of the "Invite Friends" [PC] [CS][/b][/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/50cbc7a1ea9bd56d957f9cfaf9065d993f6ae0db.jpg[/img]
The "Invite Friends" option has been removed from the lobby screen. Please use "Find the lobby" using "Lobby ID" when playing with friends.
[*][h4][b]Addition of Item to Options [CS][/b][/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/da94ff3fb7faa5a3dd53aeae3327f57560388707.png[/img]
You can now toggle the cross-play function on/off. If it's off, matching with players on different platforms will be rejected. Please check this item if you are unable to match with CS version players.
[/list]

[h3][b]Addition of "Recently played players"[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][h4][b]You can check played players and also block or report them [CS][/b][/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a5d98412158caa63c0f2cb3e9bc67626b46095d7.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h3][b]Addition of Communication Phrases[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][h4][b]Communicate about skills! [PC] [CS][/b][/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a04ddc5593b34910fb5e359f28494f12be264c9a.jpg[/img]
You can now communicate the skills you possess and the number of mana points you have. The content of the communication will change depending on the state of the skill (cool time, lack of mana, available). We have also made adjustments to existing communication phrases.
[/list]

[h3][b]Adjustments to Existing Active Skills[/b][/h3]
[b]Knight[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased mana cost of "Sword Edge"
Mana Cost: 4 ⇒ [b]2[/b]
[*] Reduced base damage of "Sword Edge"
Damage: 300 ⇒ [b]200[/b]
[*] Decreased cool time of "Ultimate Force"
CoolTime: 40 sec ⇒ [b]30 sec[/b]
[*] Modified the effect of "Ultimate Force"
Old: [strike]Attack the enemy with damage equivalent to the hate value accumulated on you. After the attack, your own hate value is reduced to 0.[/strike]
New: [b]Attack the enemy with damage equivalent to the hate value accumulated on you.[/b]
[quote=GD] We have removed the effect of reducing hate value to 0. This allows knights who continue to participate in battles to deal stable damage. However, there is a limit to the base damage, and it does not increase indefinitely. [/quote]
[/list]
[b]Priest[/b]
[list]
[*] Added effect to "Presto"
Old: [strike]For 10 seconds, "Attack Haste" is granted all players.[/strike]
New: For 10 seconds, "Attack Haste" is granted all players. Reduces everyone`s skill cool time by 20%.
[quote=GD] Adjusted to a skill that can contribute more to the party. [/quote]
[/list]
[b]Wizard[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified the effect of "Flame Aura" granted "Fire Boost"
Old: [strike]"Fire Boost" Damage dealt is increased by 10% and fire damage is increased by 50%.[/strike]
New: "Fire Boost" Increases fire damage by 60% and grants "Ignited" to normal attacks.
[quote=GD] Adjusted to a more versatile effect, perfect for fire damage. [/quote]
[/list]

[h3][b]Discontinuation of Cloud Saves[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][h4][b]We have temporarily stopped cloud saves due to the implementation of cross-play [PC][/b][/h4]
Save data will be saved in the local save folder.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the hate value reset display was not functioning properly after multiplayer play.
[*] Corrected some translations.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
We sincerely apologize for the long wait! Thank you very much for your numerous feedback, opinions, and support.

We look forward to your continued support for "TrinityS" in the future.

notes.title: [4.26 Announcement] Official Release/Cross-Play Implementation Scheduled!!
notes.notes:
To all the brave adventurers who enjoy their daily quests,
It's the TrinityS development team.

[hr][/hr]
TrinityS is approaching its milestone of two years since its Early Access release on Steam! Last October, the console version was also released, and we have received even more players since then.

As TrinityS reaches its two-year milestone...
We are planning to [b]officially release the Steam version[/b] and [b]implement cross-play with the console version[/b] on April 26th (Friday)!

With this update, we hope to break down the barriers between platforms and allow adventurers to enjoy adventures with various people.

[hr][/hr]
The update is scheduled to be released on April 26th (Friday) at 12:00 PM JST.
Please check the patch notes that will be posted at the time of release for detailed update information!

Thank you for your continued support for TrinityS.

notes.title: Major Update [Patch Notes] 0.3.0.0
notes.notes:
Challengers! Hello!
This is 『TrinityS』 development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
For a long time, updates to TrinityS had stopped.
We're pleased to announce a major update!

The Hard Mode has been implemented in this update. You all can enjoy battles against more powerful bosses.
We've also added a lot of systems and made a lot of improvements to the game, including some UI fixes, with a focus on ease of play!

<About the update>
[list]
[*]Finally, 'Hard Mode' is unleashed!
[*]'Character customization' is added.
[*]'Missions' is added.
[*]Lobby system renewed.
[*]'Continue' is added.
[*]New skills are added.
[*]Adjustments to existing skills.
[*]New Steam achievements added.
[/list]
For more information see.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Update[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]'Hard Mode' is unleashed![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/007b8aeb09b8215fbcb3dcb9adc9ac6a1416848e.png[/img]
All the boss monsters are once again upon the adventurers! They are enhanced with vicious feats.
A completely different experience awaits you in Normal Mode!

[b]Hard mode features[/b]
[list]
[*]Only three-player games are supported.
[*]You cannot play with COMs (AI).
[*]Only players who have completed Normal Mode will be able to play.
[*]There are multiple boss action patterns, which change with each sortie. (They do not change during the battle.)
[/list]

[h3][b]'Character customization' is added.[/b][/h3]
A system to change the appearance of each character has been added.
Complete missions to get weapon skins and character skins and customize your character to your liking!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/da48c9bfcd8c0ac0082ab5ba19a7b4e1022666de.png[/img]
*Customization reflects appearance only and does not reflect on status.

[h3][b]'Missions' is added.[/b][/h3]
We have implemented missions that will be one of your goals when you play.
Completing missions earns you new skins and other items that can be used for customization.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/6c82145f52699b531a6a9b9d7f67b66ad79edab6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Lobby system renewed.[/b][/h3]
The previous Quick Match system was designed specifically to quickly gather party members, but it was difficult to recruit party members with the same objectives for the strategy.

With this update, the Quick Match system has been discontinued and a screen has been implemented to allow users to [b]search for lobbies[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/63a63ad524d7a8083e0acd4c6c3f9aeb38b38359.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/8c8feacaef397c604047fcf1310ccfb812dc3606.png[/img]
Lobby creators can now change their play style from the settings, allowing them to gather party members that match their proficiency and strategy goals.
This is also very helpful if you want to play in a particular role, as you can check which roles have already been selected before entering the room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/1b7540e6eb193e55d112e91ab7e6bfe5a0c714ad.png[/img]
Lobby IDs are also available and can be used to recruit parties outside the game.
*Searching by lobby ID is possible even if the lobby setting is private.

Please use the official Discord for party recruitment.
Click on this to join the discord. 
[url=https://t.co/ognqOJghHm][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/03adfaaca645e260376a31e3968685b478db1e95.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]'Continue' is added.[/b][/h3]
A system has been added that allows the user to start the same stage again when a battle has been terminated due to a network error, for example.
An 'adventure record' is created at the end of a battle, and players with the same adventure record can re-launch the battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/1aa24b10b676de6e600da189149e2330e135e70a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/c9481782b4df1e6b61b470e1518f546a65e3366e.png[/img]

[quote=GD]Many players were forced to spend long periods of time and play through very stressful stages that they finally cleared only to have to start over due to network errors. Since Hard Mode requires a longer time to conquer than ever before, this will be a very useful feature. 
[/quote]

[h3][b]New Active Skills are added.[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Knight "Hate Assemble"[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/fcbb5a7d04f520c59294e7d2d7fa026727e1ce84.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/698bae3612bc34600738c99b77e0cf0fb3cc9d98.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Reduced mana costs for 'Howling'.
Mana Cost : 4 ⇒ [b]3[/b]
[*]Decreased cool time for 'Fortress'.
Cool Time : 30 ⇒ [b]24[/b]
[*]'Spirit Charge' increases 'HATE' significantly.
Old: [strike]For 15 seconds, "Volitional" is granted you.[/strike]
New: [b]It becomes easier to be targeted by the enemy. For 15 seconds, "Volitional" is granted you.[/b]
[*]'Defensive Aura' modified to grant 'Iron Wall' to all party members.
Old: [strike]Restores you 100 HP. For 15 seconds, "Iron Wall" is granted you.[/strike]　
New: Restores you 100 HP. For 10 seconds, "Iron Wall" is granted [b]all players[/b].
[/list]

[b]Priest[/b]
[list]
[*]Corrected effect text for 'Heal Area'.
Old: [strike]It gradually heals players in the area.[/strike]
New: It heals [b]25 HP[/b] of players in the area every second.
[*]'Regeneration' effect duration extended.
Duration of effect: 10 sec ⇒ [b]12 sec[/b]
[*]Decreased cool time for 'Divine Aura'.
Cool Time: 20 sec ⇒ [b]12 sec[/b]
[*]Increased mana costs for 'Resolute'.
Mana Cost: 3 ⇒ [b]5[/b]
[/list]

[b]Initial skills changes.[/b]
"Cure" has been added to Priests' initial skills.
This has removed 'Forte Shock' from the initial skill set.
Priests' initial skills are Divine Aura, Heal Area and Cure.
[quote=GD] We believe that the usage rate of the Cure is increasing as the later stages progress, and that it is recognised as one of the essential skills, for example by resetting the game in Normal Mode if the player does not have the Cure. Of course, we have confirmed that it is possible to clear the final stage without this skill, but we decided to include the key skill in the strategy as an initial skill to avoid situations where it does not even exist as an option. We believe there is still room for improvement in the system itself, such as the fact that the abnormalities generated by the bosses are too powerful and the balance of each skill is unbalanced, so we plan to make further updates to the system, including the skill effects. [/quote]

[b]Wizard[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced duration of effect of 'Nitro Shot'.
Duration of effect: 20 sec ⇒ [b]15 sec[/b]
[*]Increased cool time for 'Megiddo Flame'.
Cool Time: 32 sec ⇒ [b]45 sec[/b]
[*]Reduced cool time and mana cost for 'Resovaleno'.
Cool Time: 55 sec ⇒ [b]45 sec[/b]
Mana Cost: 8 ⇒ [b]7[/b]
[*]Decreased cool time on 'Flame Aura'.
Cool Time: 50 sec ⇒ [b]35 sec[/b]
[*]Certain moves used by bosses when using 'Seven Dimension' can no longer be evaded.
[quote=GD]This skill was designed to maintain the player's passive levels while stopping the player from attacking the boss, but it is increasingly being used as a means of forcing the player to break through the boss's powerful gimmicks. While this skill is very stylish and can be a hero in a party, we have modified the overly powerful effect to be more in line with the design intent. [/quote]
[/list]

[h3][b]New Steam achievements added.[/b][/h3]
10 Steam Achievements have been added with this update.

[h3][b]About resetting saved data[/b][/h3]
Saved data prior to 0.3.0.0 has been reset.
This requires a tutorial when the game is launched, and Hard Mode cannot be joined until Normal Mode is completed again.
Also, the options have been restored to their default settings, so please check again.
(Graphic settings may remain available).
Steam achievements will be carried over. Almost all skills have been adjusted, new skills are present and will be reflected in the missions, so we invite you to play the new and improved TrinityS.
[quote=GD] The update adds various parameters, and in order to prevent problems with game progression due to inconsistencies with previous save data, we have decided to reset your game data once. [/quote]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where characters receiving knockback were not synchronising properly.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Dark Breath effect on Stage 5 Cerberus was not disappearing correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue where attacks that reduced movement speed did not reflect the movement speed effect correctly.
[*]Fixed a problem where the clear stage number was not reflected correctly when clearing the final stage.
[*]Fixed an issue where combat would not start on retry.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
We are sorry for the really long wait.
Thank you very much for all the feedback, opinions and support.


Please continue to support 'TrinityS'.

notes.title: First major update to early access of TrinityS has a new release date!
notes.notes:
Challengers! Hello!
This is TrinityS development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
We are very happy to finally be able to deliver the announcement of the major update to you, as we have continued to develop the game to the best of our ability based on your feedback and support. Thank you very much for your support.

Now, the first major update for the early access version of the game, we have decided to deliver it on [u][b]December 23, 2022 (JST)[/b][/u]!
To celebrate the big update and to coincide with the Steam Winter Sale, we will be holding a 20% off sale, so be sure to grab your friends and challenge the more vicious boss monsters during the New Year's holiday!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Major Update Details[/h2]
The early access major update of TrinityS adds new main content such as [b]Hard Mode[/b], [b]Mission[/b], and [b]Customize[/b], as well as a variety of game tweaks and enhancements. We are also making a wide variety of adjustments to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/9b1754859b2a374dc0f02b5395985f4825db7b92.jpg[/img]

[h2]'Hard Mode'[/h2]
This is a new mode in which the boss monsters appear with vicious techniques.
Hard Mode can only be played by players who have cleared Normal Mode, and can only be attempted by three players. The boss monsters in this mode are much more fearsome than those that existed before the major update, so be sure to invite your friends to join you in the challenge!
* The mode that could be challenged before the major update is called 'Normal Mode' and the new mode added this time is called 'Hard Mode'.
* You cannot play with COM (AI).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/bdd54cf78174448de9dccd715dade53151b3f145.jpg[/img]

[h2]'Missions'[/h2]
A wide variety of new missions are available for players to try.
By completing missions, players can obtain new skins that can be used in the 'Customize' feature. Let's try our best to complete all the missions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/6c82145f52699b531a6a9b9d7f67b66ad79edab6.png[/img]

[h2]'Character customization'[/h2]
You can change the look of your character, weapons, and pins with skins obtained from the `Mission` feature.
Whether you want to change the look of your character to your favorite look or equip a hard-to-find skin to show other players how much you've done, customize your character with the skin of your choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/da48c9bfcd8c0ac0082ab5ba19a7b4e1022666de.png[/img]

[h2]New systems such as 'Lobby System' and 'Continue' features![/h2]
In addition to the 'Hard Mode', 'Mission' and 'Customize' features, which are the main contents of this major update, various adjustments have been made to existing systems to make the game even easier to play. For example, the existing 'Quick Match System' has been eliminated and a new 'Lobby System' has been introduced. This allows players to create and search for lobbies at their discretion, allowing them to play the game for various purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/63a63ad524d7a8083e0acd4c6c3f9aeb38b38359.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/1b7540e6eb193e55d112e91ab7e6bfe5a0c714ad.png[/img]

In addition, when a game is terminated due to a network error or other reason, it is necessary to start over from the beginning of the stage, but by using the 'Continue'  features to be introduced this time, it will be possible to start from the same stage that was last played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/c9481782b4df1e6b61b470e1518f546a65e3366e.png[/img]

Other content includes new skills, adjustments to existing skills, new Steam achievements for hard mode, and more.
For more details, please see the patch notes that will be distributed on the same day.

[hr][/hr]
We are sorry for the really long wait.
Thank you very much for all the feedback, opinions and support.

Please continue to support 'TrinityS'.

notes.title: Early Access Release of TrinityS!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers
Finally, we are pleased to announce the release of the Early Access version of TrinityS on April 28, 2022 at 12:00 JST!
The game is available in Japanese and English and supports online multiplayer for up to three players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/586b11cd3e9c38de0f1027c3db3909a6c7fcd9cc.png[/img]

TrinityS sells for $14.99.
To celebrate the release of the Early Access version, a one-week-only sale is also being offered.
[u][b]Now you can get it at a 20% discounted price![/b][/u]

The bundle, which includes the soundtrack released at the same time, is also on sale for a much lower price to celebrate its release!

Come play at TrinityS this weekend!
